scope: History writer handoff production and five scalar controls; not the in-progress History pre-close/fence oracle or CI reader

resolved_finding.issue: Earlier version additionally refused unqualified/replayed work for negative stored free credit despite a successful original paid-reserve sampler verdict.
resolved_finding.resolution: ready = !state.verified_completion || budget.credit_ns >= 0; noneligible returns without wait or new refusal, while true deficits/refused/unknown remain sampler errors.
resolved_finding.regression: same negative-free successful purchased-allowance continuation, followed by real unsampled W1 depletion and original refusal; no fabricated credit or CPU

checked: before_writer runs only after successful detached execution with Node guard dropped and scoped workers joined; held, capacity fallback and existing-packet branches do not call it
same operation uses observe_sample(false,true) for each new owner interval; no new reservation, settlement, reset, credit mint or worker-account change
request/global mutexes leave lexical scope before resource callback, request check and sleep; lock order remains request then global
same original request deadline and resource closure check every wait, five-millisecond waits clamp to original end, no deadline replacement
only original unique verified-completion promotion can wait; original completion identity/replay/capacity rules are unchanged
all current start and termination reserves remain deducted from stored free credit; eligible readiness at C>=0 does not promise commit success
preexisting refusal and unknown accounting cannot revive; thread/owner registry inconsistencies fail closed
held checks and commit fences remain active after reacquisition; another owner can consume headroom and cause legitimate refusal
two-live-owner test uses different actual OS threads, avoiding overlapping same-thread meter baselines; actual receipts and flow sum check double payment
five tests use actual valid W1 and actual thread CPU, cold original refill, original deadlines and real wait; unknown sampler failure is an explicit failure-injection control
consume_free_credit no longer demands extra replays when qualifying real work already reached the target
limits: No Cargo, compiler, native test, service campaign or throughput observation was run by this reviewer.

Real-CPU deficit fixtures require CPU consumption to outpace the original 250 ms/s refill before their five-second end; a heavily throttled environment can fail setup and must not be counted as a mechanism counterexample.
Component try_lock controls cover request/global mutexes; Node writer release is verified from production call structure and still needs the full native History controls.
C>=0 is a sampled readiness condition, not a reservation for future commit or a commit-cost upper bound.
